Mom! Dad! Black Friday just started! Everything is ninety percent off!
Then the stores make one tiny mistake. The sale never ends. Not tomorrow. Not ever.
Day one. Dad buys ten TVs. You have one living room.
They were ninety percent off! I saved thousands!
Day three. Mom fights a grandma for the last toaster. The grandma wins.
Day seven. The stores are empty. Every shelf. Everything is sold.
And when you sell everything for almost nothing, you can't pay the people who make it. The factories close.
Can we buy a new toaster?
There are no new toasters. Ever.
So now you have ten TVs, zero toasters, and nothing left to buy.
At least the TVs were cheap.
